description: Manage offers in the ATS. Actions: create (validate & structure), update_status (draft→pending-approval→approved→sent→accepted/declined), delete (remove offer), list (all offers with optional filters), compare (side-by-side offer comparison), validate (check for issues). Returns structured offer data.
